articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎnr diǎnxin. Duōshao qián yìjīn?
MR. ANDERSON: I'd like to buy some pastries. How much are they per catty?
SHOP ASSISTANT: Eighty cents a catty.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐng ni gěi wo liǎngjīn.
MR. ANDERSON: Please give me two catties.
DIÀNYUÁN: Hǎo. Nín hái yào diǎnr shénme?
SHOP ASSISTANT: Certainly. What else do you want?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ hái yào qìshuǐ. Duōshao qián yìpíng?
MR. ANDERSON: I want some soda too. How much is it per bottle?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Hǎo. Zhèi shi sānkuài qián. Wǒ bú yào shenme le.
MR. ANDERSON: Fine. Here's three dollars. I don't want anything else.
DIÀNYUÁN: Zhǎo ni yíkuài qián. Xièxie. Zàijiàn.
SHOP ASSISTANT: Here's one dollar in change. Thank you. Good-bye.
